entities.name: Anti-Miscegenation Laws
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Virginia banned interracial marriage in 1691. By 1924, 30 US states prohibited marriage between white and non-white people. Nazi Germany's Nuremberg Laws (1935) banned marriages between Jews and non-Jews. These laws were tools of racial hierarchy masked as "protecting" marriage.
